blurb: Guests can book fishing charters of various durations or join shark tooth hunting trips exploring local riverbanks and beaches. Trips are scheduled around tides for optimal experience. A sunset cruise is also offered for a relaxing view of Savannah's marshland.
extraNote: $100 deposit due at time of booking · Tip not included in advertised price · 10% discount for current and former military and first responders with valid ID · Catch limits implemented for certain species, see FAQ · Bahia Bleu (for fishing charters)
